binarytrees.notes: bench(n): binary-trees with max depth n (stretch tree n+1, long-lived tree n, 2^(n-d+4) trees of each even depth d from 4); result = FNV-1a of the bytes BG prints. BG runs n=21.

fannkuchredux.notes: bench(n): fannkuch-redux over all n! permutations; result = FNV-1a of the bytes BG prints ("%d\nPfannkuchen(%d) = %d\n"). BG runs n=12.

fasta.notes: bench(n): BG fasta for n; result = FNV-1a of the bytes BG prints (10.2 n bytes). BG runs n=25,000,000.

knucleotide.notes: setup(n): BG fasta's output for n (untimed). bench(n): k-nucleotide over it (find >THREE, encode, count 1-, 2-mers and the 5 fragments); result = FNV-1a of the bytes BG prints. n=1000 -> 2506903540 (BG's knucleotide-output.txt). BG runs fasta 25,000,000.

mandelbrot.notes: bench(n): the BG program for an n x n bitmap; result = FNV-1a of the bytes BG prints ("P4\n<n> <n>\n" and the bitmap). BG runs n=16,000.

nbody.notes: bench(n): n steps of 0.01 from the BG initial state; result = FNV-1a of the two "%.9f\n" energy lines BG prints. BG runs n=50,000,000.

pidigits.notes: bench(n): the first n digits of pi by BG's spigot; result = FNV-1a of the bytes BG prints (10 digits, "\t:<count>\n" per line, the last line padded with spaces). BG runs n=10,000.

regexredux.notes: setup(n): BG fasta's output for n (untimed). bench(n): regex-redux over it (strip headers/newlines, count the 9 variants, the 5 replacements, the three lengths); result = FNV-1a of the bytes BG prints. n=1000 -> 2596312850 (BG's regexredux-output.txt). BG runs fasta 5,000,000.

revcomp.notes: setup(n): the fasta output for n (BG fasta's algorithm, 10.2 n bytes), untimed. bench(n): BG revcomp of it; result = FNV-1a of the bytes BG prints. BG runs fasta 25,000,000's output (n = 25,000,000).

spectralnorm.notes: bench(n): the BG program for n; result = FNV-1a of the "%.9f\n" line BG prints. BG runs n=5,500.
